We compared the effects of N-acetylcysteine (NAC), theophylline or sodium bicarbonate on intrarenal vasoconstriction and ROS generation in a rat model of CM-induced nephropathy. Methods: Following a 3-day dehydration, Sprague-Dawley rats received CM (Telebrix) or sham ‘CM’ injection of 0.9% saline. Part of them received NAC, theophylline or bicarbonate prior to CM.
